name: Playwright CLI (playwright)
description: Installs the Playwright CLI (`playwright`) globally via npm, plus browser binaries into a shared location usable by every user in the container.

version.description: Version of the `playwright` npm package to install (e.g. 1.48.0). Use 'latest' for the newest release.

browsers.description: Which browser binaries to download. Comma-separated list of chromium/firefox/webkit, 'all' for every browser, or 'none' to install only the CLI.

installDeps.description: Install the OS-level packages the browsers need (via `playwright install-deps`). Requires an apt-based base image.
